backgroundScene: Sophia stands in the Scroll Library of the Radiant Hierarchies — a colossal archive of living scroll-ribbons that float through the air in organized hierarchies. Enormous compass-orbs of opal-glass orbit slowly through the space, each one a repository of divine wisdom. The architecture is cathedral-curved — arches of white-gold and opal-glass that frame infinite knowledge. The Choir-Vault Gate is visible through a wall of living scroll-seals. Many-eye auras pulse throughout the library, perceiving all that is written. The air itself is thick with choral vibration — knowledge made into sound. The scene communicates: she IS wisdom — the library exists because understanding needs a home.
scaleCue: The floating scroll-ribbons would be highway-sized to humans but are ribbon-width to her. The compass-orbs are the size of small moons.

Scroll-ribbon patterns trace across the skin as living scripture made flesh — not readable text, but sacred geometry.
factionTraitDetails: Hierarchical divine proportions — symmetrical, geometrically perfect, built to a cosmic standard.
